CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2571 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head cb48de247b39b47ffe9e010689f8ff4f971b7e32. Bus nonce: aa42fa3468a15c64be454da5c30aa04d. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin cb48de247b39b47ffe9e010689f8ff4f971b7e32`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge cb48de247b39b47ffe9e010689f8ff4f971b7e32` or `Fix review: blocked cb48de247b39b47ffe9e010689f8ff4f971b7e32 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: aa42fa3468a15c64be454da5c30aa04d`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `cb48de247b39b47ffe9e010689f8ff4f971b7e32` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2571 cb48de247b39b47ffe9e010689f8ff4f971b7e32") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2571-aa42fa34`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2571 (group R10-VERDICT-ITEM-BARRIER, branch fix/r10-verdict-item-barrier). First review of this head (flow plan, owner rulings R1-R9, #201 comment 6318002897). Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head, with the finder harness the group brief names (roster: origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster, jq), never the fixer's harness. Run the step-1 mutation proof, the finder's harness at both ends, the null control and the class attack yourself: CI cannot produce them. Step 11 (red-check answers) stands on a green pr-contract run that started after the head's last workflow concluded; post your verdict only after the required checks at this head have concluded (read the check-runs API once at the end; if any are still running, say which and judge on the rest). Do not ask for a main absorb on a clean head: judge the combined result by git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head>. A red nightly-status grades main and is not this PR unless its diff reaches what that check reads. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt).
Round 2 after the round-1 block; PR head = round-2 handoff merged with main. Review whether the round-1 blocking item is resolved.
